ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.
